docs.abstract: The Justice Department could push for the tech giant to sell off a business to end its lock on online search. But a move would be tough to pull off.

byline.original: By Andrew Ross Sorkin, Ravi Mattu, Bernhard Warner, Sarah Kessler, Michael J. de la Merced, Lauren Hirsch and Ephrat Livni

headline.main: Why Breaking Up Google Would Be Hard to Do

multimedia.caption: The Biden administration may ask for a breakup of Google to end the tech giant’s lock on search.
multimedia.credit: Jason Henry for The New York Times
